# InNetworkSignalRecovery

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Performing waveform reconstruction directly within network nodes using reservoir computing, rather than at end hosts, to reduce backhaul traffic and latency. Enables distributed, topology-centric signal processing, improving scalability and efficiency of data-intensive network architectures.
